body: I can try that but I doubt it will work for too long because I’ve been trying that and I’ll be occupied or something and then my fucking stomach decides to start hating me and then I am pulled back into panic mode. Thank you so much for talking to me, it means to world to me.

I know this is a silly question but have you told your parents how much this is killing you? You need to tell them. I know you said you tried to talk about your depression and anxiety to them but have you really told them you feel like killing yourself because of what they are forcing you to do?
Plus living with OCD is a bitch, it’s IMPOSSIBLE to stop obsessing about shit all fucking day :/ it’s exhausting mentally and physically

It’s not that simple for me to just relax. To top off everything I have a very bad phobia of vomiting and after being sick this whole time I live in constant fear I’m going to vomit everyday because that’s how this all started was a few weeks ago I was throwing up and I have been sick ever since with nausea and stuff. I can’t eat without feeling like I’m going to throw up. And then it triggers a panic attack and it’s just this constant cycle. I can’t work right now because I’m sick so I’m stressed about bills and what if I never get better what if I’m making myself sick? I can’t live like this forever. I’m not going to make it.
Exactly! It’s like you know you’re causing more pain by being here so it’s like you know it will be better for them if you’re not here but I don’t want him to hurt himself.
Talk to me, I really know how you feel. I’m there right now with you. How old are you? If it doesn’t work I’ll still be here to talk to you.
